pre_outcome_review_corrections: Require telemetry status plus non-empty resource samples for every task-arm.
Require every selected source image to be absent before and after each arm.
Rebuild task-level quality artifacts from disk when resuming.
Preserve invalid or absent fresh-run result state during arm-level resume.
Disable the timing gate when either arm differs from the source terminal class.
Permit an empty arm-level checkpoint and select the latest attempt after retrying an interrupted arm.
Require resource samples to cover the replay action window within a frozen two-second boundary tolerance.
Treat Docker image-probe errors as invalid rather than as evidence that an image is absent.
protocol.selection_rule: preserve the previously frozen final_test order and exclude the two task units already present in older SWE result artifacts
protocol.unfinished_arm_retry_policy: rerun the full uncheckpointed arm in place and validate the highest numbered attempt for every task
protocol.lifecycle_scope: from after skipped global image prefetch/prebuild through on-demand image pull, container preparation, replay, finalization, stop, and per-task source-image removal

cost_estimate.basis: The exposed 48-task rolling replay required 17641.34 seconds across two arms; four 12-task queues execute the same 96 task-arm replays plus bounded queue setup.
cost_estimate.authorization: Human approved launch after the estimate on 2026-08-08.
